animation_styles.description: Animation styles to generate (for standard video_producer)

video_formats.description: Video formats to generate. Applies to bar race, intro, audio and merge tasks.

fps.description: Seconds per period for bar_race videos. Controls animation pace — higher = slower/longer video.
fps.tip: fps_hd_offset multiplies the per-period duration for HD. HD duration = fps × fps_hd_offset per period.

fps_hd_offset.description: Multiplier applied to fps for HD format only. Shorts uses fps directly; HD uses fps × fps_hd_offset.

video_fps.description: Output video frame rate for ALL tools (intro, bar_race, definition_video). Must be identical across all 3 tools — mismatched fps causes A/V sync failure on merge. Change here to update everywhere.
video_fps.tip: 30fps is recommended. Never mix fps values — all 3 segment tools read this single field.

use_existing_csv.description: Use existing CSV instead of generating new one. Skips research_data and generate_csv tasks. If CSV is missing, auto-generates it instead of erroring.

use_label_mappings.description: Apply label_mappings.json to shorten bar names (e.g. 'JavaScript' => 'JS'). Set false to use raw CSV column names.

definition_enabled.description: Generate a plain-English topic definition and save to output/{filename}.txt.

use_existing_definition.description: Use existing output/{filename}.txt instead of generating a new one. If the .txt is missing, auto-generates it instead of erroring.

definition_max_chars.description: Maximum characters for the topic definition text saved to output/{filename}.txt.

examples.600: Very short — one paragraph per section
examples.1200: Default — balanced length for video display
examples.2000: Long — detailed definition with more key terms

definition_video.description: Create a bottom-to-top scrolling text video from the definition .txt file. Active line is large neon white at bottom; older lines scroll up and shrink. Output: definition_video_{fmt}_with_audio.mp4.

video_enabled.description: Enable standard video generation (uses smart_video_tool with multiple animation styles).

bar_race_video_enabled.description: Enable bar race video generation using bar_race_video_tool with professional interpolation.
bar_race_video_enabled.note: Can be used WITH or WITHOUT video_enabled.

watermark_enabled.description: Overlay semi-transparent watermark text on bar race video frames.

watermark_text.description: Watermark text displayed on video. Usually '@ChannelName'. Change here to update all tools dynamically.

audio_speed.description: Speech speed for Shorts audio via ffmpeg atempo filter. 1.0=normal, <1.0=slower, >1.0=faster.
audio_speed.tip: 1.1 = slightly faster. Shorts narration is concise so a slight speed-up helps pacing.

audio_speed_hd.description: Speech speed for HD audio ONLY via ffmpeg atempo. Set 0.0 to fall back to audio_speed for all formats.

examples.0.0: No override — HD uses same speed as audio_speed
examples.0.9: Slightly faster than Shorts — good for longer HD narration

audio_speed_hd.tip: HD narration is longer (includes data points). 0.9–1.0 prevents it feeling too slow.

intro_enabled.description: Generate branded intro clip per format. Shows channel name, topic and year range on dark background. Output: intro_{fmt}_with_audio.mp4.

intro_duration.description: Duration of intro clip in seconds for Shorts/portrait formats.

intro_duration_hd.description: Duration of intro clip in seconds for HD/landscape formats. Set 0 to use intro_duration for all formats.

bar_race_video_enabled.description: Enable bar race video generation. Output: bar_race_{fmt}_with_audio.mp4 per format.

bar_merge_enabled.description: Concatenate intro + bar_race + definition_video segments into one final video per format. Output: {channel}_{topic_slug}_{fmt}.mp4. Also merges CC text files. Requires all 3 segment _with_audio.mp4 files to exist.
bar_merge_enabled.note: Segments must have identical fps (controlled by video_fps). Mismatched fps will cause A/V sync issues.

audio_enabled.description: Enable audio narration for standard (non-bar-race) videos.

merge_audio_video.description: Merge standard audio with standard video files.

generate_youtube_metadata.description: Generate YouTube metadata files (title, description, tags, chapters) and translate to 31 languages. Output saved to YT/{fmt}/MD/ and YT/{fmt}/CC/.

upload_youtube_video.description: Upload final merged videos to YouTube using YouTube Data API v3. Reads metadata from YT/{fmt}/MD/en.json. Smart skip: if YT/{fmt}/upload_log.json exists with a video_id, re-upload is skipped.
upload_youtube_video.note: Requires client_secrets.json (OAuth2 credentials from Google Cloud Console). First run opens browser for Google login and saves token.json automatically.

upload_privacy.description: YouTube video privacy setting on upload.
upload_privacy.tip: Use 'private' to review before publishing. Change to 'public' when ready.

upload_category_id.description: YouTube category ID for uploaded videos.

upload_cc.description: Upload CC/subtitle files from YT/{fmt}/CC/{lang}.txt to YouTube after video upload. Covers all 31 languages generated by yt_metadata_tool.

upload_notify_subscribers.description: Notify channel subscribers when video is uploaded. Recommended false for private/unlisted uploads.

upload_client_secrets_file.description: Path to OAuth2 client_secrets.json downloaded from Google Cloud Console. Required for first-time authentication.
upload_client_secrets_file.setup: https://console.cloud.google.com → APIs & Services → Credentials → Create OAuth 2.0 Client ID → Desktop App → Download JSON

upload_token_file.description: Path to saved OAuth2 token file. Auto-created after first browser login. Reused on subsequent runs without re-authentication.

channel.description: Channel name used in audio narration ('Welcome to X'), intro clip title, agent backstory, and YouTube metadata. No @ prefix. Change once to update everywhere.

channel_lower.description: Lowercase channel slug used in LinkedIn and other URLs.

website.description: Channel website or primary URL shown in YouTube metadata.

llm_researcher.description: LLM override for the data_researcher agent (research_data task). null = use project default.

llm_definition.description: LLM override for the definition_specialist agent (define_topic task). null = use project default. Tip: use a strong model here — this agent must compose text AND call a tool correctly in one shot.

examples.openai/gpt-4o-mini: Good balance of quality and cost
examples.anthropic/claude-3-haiku: Fast and reliable for structured output

llm_csv.description: LLM override for the csv_generator agent (generate_csv task). null = use project default.

examples.openai/gpt-4o-mini: Fast and accurate for structured data tasks

llm_video.description: LLM override for the video_producer and bar_race_video_producer agents. null = use project default.

examples.openai/gpt-4o-mini: Reliable tool calling for video tasks

llm_audio.description: LLM override for the audio_engineer and bar_race_audio_engineer agents. null = use project default.

llm_youtube.description: LLM override for the youtube_metadata_specialist agent. null = use project default.

llm_upload.description: LLM override for the youtube_upload_specialist agent (upload_youtube_video task). null = use project default.
